name: FuelEconomy.gov Web Services

provider.name: U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency

summary: Free keyless REST API for EPA fuel economy ratings, emissions and range of 1984-current vehicles, plus average fuel prices.
description: The Find-a-Car web services return the full vehicle record (MPG city/highway/combined, CO2, electric range and charging data, fuel types, annual fuel cost) by vehicle id, and menu endpoints walk year, make, model and option to find that id. Also exposed are user-reported MPG averages (ympg) and current regional fuel prices. JSON or XML is selected with the Accept header.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented; no rate-limit headers were seen.

endpoints.summary: Models for a year and make
Full vehicle record including ratings and emissions

license.name: U.S. Government data; no license statement found on the docs page

agent_notes: Walk menu/year, menu/make, menu/model, menu/options to get a vehicle id, then GET /vehicle/{id}. Send Accept: application/json. Fields are strings. Docs page says the vehicle table was last updated 2026-11-04.
caveats: When a menu has exactly one entry, menuItem is an object, not an array; normalise before iterating.
Without an Accept header the response is XML.
Rate limits and the data license are not stated on the docs page (not confirmed).

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without credentials.
